unitConvention: K=1000, M=1000000; cumulative provider-reported input includes cached tokens where the provider reports them. Cost accounting separately uses provider pricing.
countingScope: Sum across roles, continuations, reviews and retries in one trial; not context-window capacity or per-response maxOutputTokens.

canary.source: Frozen task.yaml request/tool/time limits; model runner maxOutputTokens=2048 per response.

repoqa-navigation.scope: Initial single-worker derived navigation baseline; official SNF and later multi-reader comparisons separately preregistered.

bug-discovery.scope: Discovery plus independent verifier aggregate; same limits for each positive/negative sample.

multi-agent.countingScope: Every role in one scenario/configuration/trial shares the referenced cap.

large-module-role.scope: Cumulative limit for each applicable role on a large module, across continuations; reserved profile, not used in this small test suite.
large-module-role.activation: Only when a future large-module task explicitly selects this profile.
large-module-role.interpretationSource: User clarified cumulative role use; shared-module aggregate budget remains to be specified for that future task.

onExhaustion: Record budget_exhausted or timeout in the preserved trial; do not silently increase budget/retry or keep only the best result.
comparisonRules: Same model and total input/output/tool/time budgets for paired configurations.
Coordinator and reviewer consumption count toward the same trial total.
Changing a budget, model, input or scorer after results requires a new explicit preregistered revision; retain previous trials.

implementationGuard.reason: Existing runtime.tokenBudget is context-window capacity. Separate cumulative input/output caps across roles need RAT-02/03/04/08 host accounting; do not assign these large cumulative values to runtime.tokenBudget.
